validation_boundary: The authoritative project Pydantic model, sufficiency validator, serialization schema, and exact SEA v4 protocol were not directly retrievable. This run therefore uses a strict local Pydantic contract and its generated JSON Schema reconstructed from recent validated project LiteratureAtom outputs, plus local sufficiency checks for the generic atom kinds used here. It does not claim execution of the unavailable authoritative project code.

duplicate_review.note: Repeated clinical concepts are retained when they are separate numbered source recommendations; exact duplicate atom IDs were not found.

consistency_review.finding: Class of Recommendation, Level of Evidence, and economic value grades are preserved in tags and canonical source text. Underlying study results remain secondary reports in SEA rather than primary-study LiteratureAtoms.

schema_gaps: The recovered LiteratureAtom pattern has no dedicated guideline_recommendation or economic_value_statement atom kind. Formal guidance is represented as atom_kind="other" with descriptive tags.
COR, LOE, and economic value grade are preserved as tags rather than dedicated typed fields.
The source is a clinical practice guideline. Trial effects summarized by the guideline are secondary evidence reports; primary-study atoms require the cited original publications.
extraction_limitations: The main guideline's 177 COR/LOE recommendations and 12 economic value statements were parsed from the recommendation tables and checked for within-section numbering consistency.
The 807-page PDF of the Online Data Supplement spans printed source pagination 1-844 and was used for section-level evidence reconciliation; its individual study rows were not atomized.
Reference entries were extracted separately to Markdown and were not atomized.
All atoms remain needs_review because no human verification step is represented.
